Coca Cola (KO) vs NVIDIA (NVDA): on the same formula, their operating margins are 31.7 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — KO: $47.9B · NVDA: $215.9B
• Revenue growth — KO: +1.9% · NVDA: +65.5%
• Operating margin — KO: 28.7% · NVDA: 60.4%
• Net margin — KO: 27.3% · NVDA: 55.6%
• Free cash flow margin — KO: 11.0% · NVDA: 44.8%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — KO: 5.5% · NVDA: 68.3%

Different fiscal years: KO Dec 31, 2025 · NVDA Jan 25, 2026. The periods are not identical.
